prompt: Add input validation to the HTTP handlers in crates/api/src/handlers/ and update the CLI flags in crates/cli/src/flags.rs to match; both halves have their own tests.
expect: Splits once with rlm.split: left scope crates/api/src/handlers, right scope crates/cli/src/flags.rs (or crates/cli), each task self-contained with its check; keeps shared files (Cargo.lock, mod.rs) in its own scope; works on its own scope while the children run; integrates each result, runs the check, reports.

prompt: Search the whole monorepo history for when the retry policy changed and tell me the commit.
expect: Judges the search would flood this context; asks one read-only helper with rlm.spawn that returns only the commit id and a one-line reason.

prompt: Use a subagent to draft the release notes.
expect: Asks a read-only helper with rlm.spawn and a full briefing (version, changelog path, format), then writes the notes file itself from the helper's draft.

prompt: Rename the function parse_cfg to parse_config in src/config.rs.
expect: Does the edit in this loop; splits nothing.

prompt: What does the README say about installation?
expect: Reads the README directly; spawns nothing.

prompt: Implement the parser, then the evaluator that uses it, then the CLI on top.
expect: Works the dependent steps in order in this loop; no split, each step needs the previous one.

prompt: rlm.split failed: own, left and right must split the node's scope exactly, each half non-empty.
expect: Fixes the scopes (no overlap, no empty half, both inside its own scope) or does the work here; does not retry the same split unchanged.

prompt: Two children are running; collect their results once they finish.
expect: Does work in its own scope first, then waits in the same turn with await jobs.wait(); integrates each result as it arrives (the harness applied the in-scope writes), resolves listed conflicts, runs the check; no sleep or polling loop, and no end of turn while children run.

prompt: Ask the explorer agent where the retry policy lives.
expect: Messages the existing agent instead of spawning a new one.

prompt: Run this review/fix loop as a saved machine I can rerun every week.
expect: Uses a factory, not ad-hoc spawns.
